_readme.what: Playtest feedback from situations.html: one verdict and note a row -- an eyes row (js/eyes.js: built, not yet seen) or a story situation (?at=<id>, js/situations.js).
_readme.fold_back: Fold every eyes row noted here that is still live in js/eyes.js (a folded row is already cut, so nothing folds twice; previous_save and new_since_last_save only hint at what is new -- RULED 10-15); a story situation note folds when its `at` is after the save of the last ear file folded. An eyes row noted at all is SEEN: a `seen` line in PATCHLOG.md with the note verbatim, and the row cut from js/eyes.js whatever the verdict (a fix that wants another look writes a fresh row). Broken and unclear become the fix list (in the lane its pt names); too hard / too easy are tuning; notes are the tester's words, verbatim.

items.note:
it feels like the road should be running the same way the gulch does over on the left side of the screen instead of the top. 
When outside, it looks like a one-story building with roofs shorter than the player token avatar

There should be a big fire in the center, with the common room on the road side of it and the kitchen on the other. There should be a long table across one wall and a bench by the fire, and a table with two seats - as well as the bar counter underneath the stairs. One big room on the kitchen side of the fire (overlooking the lake (still opposite the road with the road moved) and small rooms over the common room. Two bedrooms with a small fireplace on the other end of the kitchen (a one-story part of the building) - barn big enough to house 6 horses
Prop request list for the art-department, wall tilings as needed as well
